_comment: The single source of truth for what a slip SAYS. Read by components/pos/Receipt.tsx (screen + browser print) and by bridge/escpos.mjs (thermal printer). Two renderers printing different return windows is a dispute at the counter, so the words live here and nowhere else. test/receipt-parity.mjs fails the build if the numbers drift from lib/types.ts.
creditKeepNote: Keep this credit note as proof of refund.
cardRefundNote: Card refunds can take 3-5 working days to reflect.
voucherSafeNote: Keep it safe - it cannot be replaced if lost.
returnLine: Returns within {days} days with this slip.
